posts.name: danmarshall14
posts.cooked:
mightyschoop:

I have 6 in the Uprising box, the promo bonus card, and 8 poison cards. 

 

This is correct.  7 main Power Cards (1 is a promo card) and 8 Poison cards (2 copies of each).  The Poison cards are used in conjunction with her powers and placed on other heroes (like Plague Rat's Infection cards from SotM)
